**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause:** Deploy `dep-4471` to the gateway, shipped by a.novak, finished at 02:14 last night. It changed one setting, `gateway.pool.perRequest`, from `false` to `true`. That made every request grab its own database connection instead of sharing them. The pool only holds 20 connections, so it filled up fast and locked out new requests.

**Impact window:** Started 02:14:18. Still going as of the last log line, 03:59:27. That's at least 1 hour 45 minutes of 503 errors on the gateway, and it hadn't recovered yet.

**What broke:** `/v1/cart`, `/v1/session`, `/v1/checkout`, `/v1/orders`, and `/v1/catalog/search` all failed with 503s. Each one paired with a pool error, `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`, and the number of requests waiting in line kept climbing, from 13 up to 74 by the end of the log.

**Roll back:** `dep-4471` on the gateway. Nothing else looks involved. I checked `worker.log` for the same stretch and it's clean, no errors, no 503s, so this stayed contained to the gateway.
